Kaya Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Ms Vasuta Agarwal as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. December 09, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kaya Limited has received the resignation of Ms. Vasuta Agarwal, DIN 07480674, from the position of Non-Executive Independent Director. The resignation is effective from the close of business hours on December 09, 2026. Ms. Agarwal cites personal and professional commitments as the reason. She will also cease to be a member of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee on the same date. The company confirms there are no other material reasons for the resignation. Ms. Agarwal currently serves as a Non-Executive Independent Director of IndiaMART InterMESH Limited, where she is a member of the Risk Management Committee and the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Kaya Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Kaya Limited filed newspaper extracts of financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on November 06, 2026. A corrigendum was published on November 08, 2026. The document also contains unrelated name change advertisements and financial data for other entities including Global Space Technologies Limited and Infra Industries Limited. Global Space Technologies Limited published results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, approved on November 05, 2026. Infra Industries Limited published results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, approved on November 06, 2026.

attchmntText: Kaya Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication- Dispatch of Postal Ballot Notice
voiceSummary: Kaya Limited has published a newspaper advertisement regarding the Notice of Postal Ballot sent to shareholders on November 06, 2026. The company proposes to seek approval of members by Postal Ballot through remote e-voting for items of Special Business mentioned in the Notice. Voting rights are reckoned as on the cut-off date of November 04, 2026. Remote e-voting commences at 9.00 a.m. on Monday, November 09, 2026, and ends at 5.00 p.m. on Tuesday, December 08, 2026. Mr. Sitansh Magia, Practicing Company Secretary, has been appointed as Scrutinizer. The results of the postal ballot will be announced within two working days from the end of remote e-voting. The advertisement was published in Financial Express and Mumbai Lakshdeep on November 07, 2026.
